description: This file defines the 'Details' class, an Android activity that displays detailed information passed via an Intent, with functionality to refresh data through a menu and print data to stdout.

classes.name: Details
classes.description: An Android activity class that displays detailed data in a scrollable view, with options to requery data from a content provider and print data to stdout.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and loads data passed via intent.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when activity resumes; currently calls superclass implementation.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates options menu with 'Requery' and 'Print to stdout' actions.

methods.name: addDataViews
methods.description: Constructs the UI views for each data item.

methods.name: makeView
methods.description: Creates a TextView with specified string, style, and size.
